newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan likely to offer 6-yr JGBs on Tuesday - sources.
newsitem.headline: Japan likely to offer 6-yr JGBs on Tuesday - sources.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer six-year government bonds through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, market sources said on Friday.
The issue amount is likely to be about 500 billion yen, bond traders said.
The MOF is also likely to offer Treasury bills (T-bills) next week, the sources said.
The T-bill issue is likely to be a rollover of about 1.2 trillion yen worth of six-month T-bills maturing on March 10, bond traders said. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-9780
